deepor.detail: No official code, checkpoint, or requirements file located anywhere. Lightweight reconstruction is mock-tested only; zero empirical result rows exist and none can exist without a released artifact.

optmath.detail: Official code and checkpoint confirmed public. No GPU inference has been run; zero result rows exist.

orlm.detail: Official code (Apache-2.0) and one public checkpoint confirmed. No GPU inference has been run against NLP4LP in this repository; zero result rows exist.

orr1.detail: Official code verified (cited directly by the arXiv paper). No SFT/TGRPO/merged checkpoint released anywhere. Faithful reproduction additionally requires training TGRPO transductively over the evaluation set itself. Zero empirical result rows exist.

ours.detail: 331-query whole-benchmark result exists (results/paper/eaai_camera_ready_tables/); a dedicated common-18-instance subset run is a separate, smaller extraction (see report §7).

pamop.detail: results/pamop/fidelity_diagnostic_gpt5/: 6 attempted, 5/6 execution success, 4/5 evaluable objective-value-proxy success. Independent reconstruction, no official code.

common_manifest.created_2026-08-13_from: baselines/{orlm,optmath,deepor,orr1}/manifests/nlp4lp_common_manifest.json, verified byte-identical across all four before this file was written
common_manifest.eligibility_rule: Natural-language problem text must be present; no outcome-based filtering.

exclusions.reason: Excluded from the pamop_possible_269 source subset before any of these 18 IDs were chosen; not an ID dropped from this manifest itself.

known_manifest_divergence.divergence_from_pilot_ids: PaMOP's actually-executed 6-problem diagnostic (14, 23, 34, 72, 84, 88) is NOT the same set as pilot_ids above (14, 23, 34, 59, 69, 72). Overlap is 4 of 6 (14, 23, 34, 72); PaMOP additionally covers 84 and 88 instead of 59 and 69.
known_manifest_divergence.resolution: Do not retroactively relabel either ID set. Both are subsets of the same 18-instance future_evaluation_ids superset below, so an 18-instance comparison remains valid; a 6-instance pilot-vs-pilot comparison must explicitly state which 6 IDs it means and must not silently treat PaMOP's pilot and the other four baselines' pilot as the same set.
known_manifest_divergence.why_this_happened: The gpt-5.4 diagnostic (results/pamop/fidelity_diagnostic_gpt5/) was run to answer a model-vs-prompt fidelity question and reused the same 6 IDs as an earlier forensics run (results/pamop/forensics_targeted/), which predates the pilot_ids convention later adopted uniformly by the ORLM/OptMATH/DeepOR/OR-R1 lightweight manifests.

common_manifest.selection_algorithm: Deterministic pamop-pilot-v1 stratified bucket pass over accessible ids 1-269 (LP/MILP, simple/multi-constraint, low/high numeric mentions, small/large partition tree, objective sense, then stable SHA-256 tie-breaking). No execution outcomes were used. See results/pamop/fidelity_diagnostic_gpt5/selected_ids.json for the full 18-row selection record with per-problem metadata.

end_to_end_objective_success_eligibility.deepor: BLOCKED. No official checkpoint or code exists to generate rows at all; the metric definition is eligible in principle (Pyomo execution + gold comparison) but UNAVAILABLE in practice.
end_to_end_objective_success_eligibility.optmath: ELIGIBLE once inference is run. Official gurobipy execution + gold objective comparison; currently PENDING (no rows exist).
end_to_end_objective_success_eligibility.orlm: ELIGIBLE once inference is run. Official coptpy execution + gold objective comparison; currently PENDING (no rows exist).
end_to_end_objective_success_eligibility.orr1: ELIGIBLE IN PRINCIPLE, WITH A MANDATORY CAVEAT. Official coptpy execution + gold objective comparison (pass@k/mj@k) is well-defined, but the official checkpoint requires training TGRPO transductively on the evaluation set itself (see docs/ORR1_PROVENANCE.md); any future row must record `transductive_training=True` and must not be silently compared to an inductively-evaluated system without that caveat surfaced in the same table.
end_to_end_objective_success_eligibility.ours: INELIGIBLE. tfidf_typed_greedy performs deterministic scalar grounding against a fixed catalog; it never generates an executable optimization instance or solves one, so steps 2 and 3 of END_TO_END_OBJECTIVE_SUCCESS ('solving succeeds', 'objective agrees') do not apply. InstantiationReady is a different claim (full, correctly-typed scalar instantiation of the single correct catalog entry) and must never be reported in the same column as objective-value agreement.
end_to_end_objective_success_eligibility.pamop: ELIGIBLE. Full AMPL formulation, solved locally with the same solver used elsewhere in this repository (HiGHS/Gurobi via AMPL), objective compared to gold with a predeclared tolerance. See results/pamop/fidelity_diagnostic_gpt5/.
